Clearing Wix cookies is one step, but connection problems usually come from the Instagram/Facebook setup. Work through these:

1. **Business account linked to a Facebook page:** your Instagram must be converted to a business account and connected to a Facebook page. If the right page is already connected, try disconnecting and reconnecting Instagram.
2. **Correct Facebook account:** check in Facebook Business Manager that you're logging in with the Facebook account that holds that page.
3. **Switching from a personal account?** Disconnect it first (Instagram Feed app → **Settings** → **Disconnect**), sign out of the personal account, sign in to the business one, then reconnect.
4. **Clear Wix cookies** from your browser if you previously connected an Instagram account, then connect again.
5. **Off-Facebook activity:** if you see an error that it's switched off, enable it in your Facebook settings.
6. **Last resort:** remove the **Wix Apps** business integration in your Facebook settings, then reconnect Instagram.

If it still fails, I can connect you with a support agent. Have your site URL, browser name/version and operating system ready.

You can restore your collection's items from a CMS backup:

1. Go to **CMS** in your site's dashboard.
2. Click **More Actions** at the top, then **Backups**.
3. Click **Restore** next to the backup from before the items changed.
4. Tick the collection(s) you want to restore.
5. Click **Restore [#] Collections**, confirm with **Yes, I am sure**, then click **Restore**.

Good to know:
- Automatic backups are saved weekly whenever you edit a collection, and you can create up to 3 manual backups.
- Restoring **permanently overwrites** any changes made after the backup date, including visitor submissions.
- Collections from Wix apps (e.g. Stores, Bookings) aren't affected by backups.
- Restoring a site version from Site History doesn't restore collection content; use CMS backups for that.

I'm sorry about the unexpected renewal. Unfortunately, the 14-day money-back guarantee only applies to **new** Premium plans. It doesn't cover **plan renewals** (or upgrades of an existing plan), even when the renewal was within the last 14 days.

However, if you believe you still deserve a refund, the support team can review your request. I'll connect you with an agent who can look at your account.

To avoid future renewals, you can turn off auto-renewal: go to **Premium Subscriptions** in your Wix account, click the **More Actions** icon next to the plan, and click **Cancel Plan**. The plan stays active until its expiration date.

"Suspended by your reseller" means your Google Workspace business email (bought through Wix) has either **expired** or has a **payment issue**. To fix it:

1. Go to your **Business Email** page in your Wix account and check the status.
2. **If it expired:** click **Renew Subscription**.
3. **If it's still active (payment problem):** go to **Payment Methods**, click **Actions → Update → Next**, enter your updated card details and click **Update**.

Also note: if the Terms of Service weren't accepted in the email admin account, the email can be suspended too. In that case you'll need to contact Wix Customer Care, and I can connect you with an agent.

response:
For a business account, verification is denied most often because the company details don't exactly match official records. Please check:

- **Company name and registration number / tax ID (EIN, VAT ID or Business ID)** must match your company's registered information.
- The **Legal Business Name, shareholder and tax ID** in the form must match those linked to your **business bank account**.
- Upload a document proving the **validity and ownership** of the tax ID. For an EIN, the company name and EIN must be clearly visible and match your Wix Payments details.
- File format: **jpeg, jpg, pdf or png**, max **10 MB** (min 1 kB for PDF, 100 kB for other formats).
- Your **Doing Business As** name should match what customers see on statements, and the address must be physical (no PO boxes).

Verification usually takes up to 7 business days (EIN checks usually 1 working day). If everything matches and it's still denied, I can connect you with a support agent to investigate.

If the sort works in Preview but not on the live site, check these:

1. **Publish again:** the live site only reflects changes after you publish.
2. **Dataset mode:** a dataset in **Write** mode can't read your collection, so it can't apply sorts. Use a mode that reads content.
3. **Collection permissions:** make sure visitors are allowed to view the content.
4. **Sandbox collection:** if you use one, sync it to the live collection.
5. **Mixed letters and numbers:** text fields are sorted alphabetically character by character, so values like "Item 10" may appear before "Item 2".

Also note that dataset sorts override the order of a collection view mirrored on the site ("Mirror on Site"), and multiple sort conditions are applied in order: the first condition first, then the next.

You can connect your Instagram business account with the **Instagram Feed** app:

**Before you start:** you need a Facebook account, and your Instagram must be a business (or creator) account connected to a Facebook page.

1. In the editor, click **Add Apps** (or **App Market**) on the left.
2. Search for **Instagram Feed** and click **Add to Site**.
3. Select the app on your page and click **Settings**.
4. Click **Connect Business Account**.
5. Log in with Facebook, select **one** Instagram business account, then the **one** Facebook page connected to it.
6. Click **Next**, review the permissions, then **Done** and **OK**.

Want Instagram **messages** in your Wix Inbox instead? Go to **Inbox → Settings → Communication Channels** and click **Connect Account** next to Instagram Business (use a desktop computer).

You can keep unfinished items off your live site by setting them to **Hidden**:

**1. Turn on item visibility control (once per collection):**
1. Go to **CMS**, open the collection, click **More Actions → Collection settings**.
2. Enable **Control item visibility**.
3. Choose **Hidden** as the default status for new items (recommended for drafts), then click **Save**.

**2. Set an item to Hidden (in the Wix Editor):**
1. Click **CMS** on the left of the editor → **Your Collections** → the collection.
2. Click the item's **Status** field and choose **Hidden**.

Hidden items can't be read by datasets, so they won't appear on your site. When the item is ready, switch it to **Visible**, or use **Schedule** in the Status field to make it visible at a set date and time. Status changes take effect immediately; no need to republish.

- **Dashboard:** go to **Invoices** in your site's dashboard to see all invoices, with filters, search and an overview of paid, outstanding and overdue amounts.

Since the stats suggest the automation ran, check these in order:

1. **Spam folder:** ask the recipient (or check your own test inbox). Whitelist **no-reply@test.wixshoutout.com** and **@automations.ascendbywix.com** (or your confirmed reply-to email).
2. **Recipient is active and valid:** the contact should show a **SUBSCRIBED** label, and the email address must be valid. Emails to inactive contacts don't go through.
3. **Form setup:** confirm the submission appears in the form's submissions table, the trigger uses the **right form**, and the form has an **email field** (required for a Send an email action).
4. **Trigger once per person:** if this is on, the contact won't get the email again.
5. **Not retroactive:** automations only run for submissions made after they were activated.
6. **Test while logged out:** if you test while logged in to Wix, your test emails merge into one contact, so delivery won't behave as expected.

If none of these explain it, I can connect you with a support agent. A screenshot or screen recording of the issue will help.
